inference: Graphics worker encounters a null input/object inside NVIDIA driver code on the Gallium path. Whether a driver defect, invalid upstream state, lifetime/race issue or prior corruption caused it is unresolved. Worker name alone does not prove a race or establish that synchronous-flush flags will fix it.
